shortDescription: Edit Application Control & URL Filtering Blades' Settings.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: block_request_when_web_service_is_unavailable
options.displayName: Block Request When Web Service Is Unavailable
options.description: Block requests when the web service is unavailable. When selected, requests are blocked when there is no connectivity to the Check Point Online Web Service. When cleared, requests are allowed when there is no connectivity. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: categorize_social_network_widgets
options.description: When selected, the Security Gateway connects to the Check Point Online Web Service to identify social networking widgets that it does not recognize. When cleared or there is no connectivity between the Security Gateway and the Check Point Online Web, the unknown widget is treated as Web Browsing traffic. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: custom_categorization_settings
options.description: Website categorization mode - select the mode that is used for website categorization. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: domain_level_permission
options.description: Allows the editing of applications, categories, and services. This property is used only in the Global Domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: enable_web_browsing
options.description: If you do not enable URL Filtering on the Security Gateway, you can use a generic Web browser application called Web Browsing in the rule. This application includes all HTTP traffic that is not a defined application Application and URL Filtering assigns Web Browsing as the default application for all HTTP traffic that does not match an application in the Application and URL Filtering Database. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: httpi_non_standard_ports
options.description: Enable HTTP inspection on non standard ports for application and URL filtering. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: internal_error_fail_mode
options.description: In case of internal system error, allow or block all connections. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: match_application_on_any_port
options.description: Match Web application on 'Any' port when used in Block rule - By default this is set to true. and so applications are matched on all services when used in a Block rule.

options.name: url_filtering_settings
options.description: In this section user can enable  URL Filtering features. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.

options.name: web_browsing_services
options.description: Web browsing services are the services that match a Web-based custom Application/Site.

options.name: website_categorization_mode
options.description: Hold - Requests are blocked until categorization is complete. Background - Requests are allowed until categorization is complete. Custom - configure different settings depending on the service. Lets you set different modes for URL Filtering and Social Networking Widgets. This property is not available in the Global domain of an MDS machine.
